target_behavior_plan: The revised reward reduces the crash_penalty scale from -50 to -25, halving the dominant penalty. This directly addresses the scale imbalance: the crash_penalty was 4.53x the next component and 16.94x the positive objective budget. With the reduced crash penalty, failed landing attempts (which currently occur in 60% of episodes) will be less costly, allowing the policy to explore more precise landings that can trigger the success_bonus (100). The success_bonus (100) remains unchanged and provides a strong terminal signal. The shaping_reward (progress-delta) continues to provide positive feedback for reducing distance and vertical speed. The leg_contact_bonus (10) remains one-shot. The fuel_penalty (-0.05) remains unchanged. The orientation_penalty (-0.1) remains unchanged. The vertical_speed_penalty (-1.0) remains unchanged. The expected outcome is that the policy will explore landing more aggressively, increasing success_like_terminal_rate from 0.4 to >=0.6 and decreasing unsafe_terminal_rate from 0.6 to <=0.3.
action_coverage_plan: Action coverage is already 100%. No changes needed. The revised reward should maintain or increase main engine usage for controlled descent and landing, while encouraging more precise use of orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to stabilize the lander on the pad.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (high altitude): shaping_reward encourages descending toward pad, fuel_penalty (-0.05) discourages excessive main engine use. Phase 2 (low altitude): shaping_reward continues, fuel_penalty continues at reduced rate, vertical_speed_penalty discourages hard landings. Phase 3 (touchdown): leg_contact_bonus and success_bonus reward proper landing. The reduced crash penalty (-25 instead of -50) makes Phase 3 failures less costly, encouraging the policy to explore more precise landings that can trigger the success_bonus.
payment_mode_plan: success_bonus is sparse (one-shot at terminal success). leg_contact_bonus is event-gated (one-shot). shaping_reward is progress-delta (not repeatable in the same sense). fuel_penalty is dense per-step penalty but now halved. orientation_penalty is dense per-step penalty. vertical_speed_penalty is dense but conditional. crash_penalty is sparse at termination but now halved. All positive terms are either sparse, event-gated, or progress-delta. No repeatable positive terms without success.
